career_ladder.note: Assistant Administrative Officers (AAO) represent the primary officer management cadre in the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). Officers oversee policy servicing, underwriting, claims settlement, marketing channel administration, and corporate accounts across divisional and branch offices nationwide.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process for LIC AAO (Generalist) consists of a Three-Tier Process: Phase-I Preliminary Examination (Screening), Phase-II Main Examination (Online Objective + Descriptive test), followed by Phase-III Interview and Pre-Recruitment Medical Examination. In Phase-I and Phase-II, English Language papers are qualifying in nature and their marks are not counted for ranking.

stages.source_label: LIC of India — Examination Scheme for AAO (Generalist)

papers.paper_name: English Language (with special emphasis on grammar, vocabulary and comprehension)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 10 (9 for SC/ST); marks not counted for ranking

stages.stage_name: Phase-II: Main Examination (Objective 300 Marks + Descriptive 25 Marks)
stages.source_label: LIC of India — Examination Scheme for AAO (Generalist)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 10 (9 for SC/ST); marks not counted for ranking

stages.source_label: LIC of India — Interview Guidelines & Selection Ratio

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Mains objective 300 marks + Interview 60 marks = 360 marks aggregate)

financial_package.pay_source_label: Life Insurance Corporation of India (Staff) Regulations, Pay Scale for AAO (₹53,600 - 2,645(14) - 90,630 - 2,865(4) - 1,02,090)
financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹53,600/month. Total monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹92,870/month in 'A' Class cities. Benefits include Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (where quarters not availed), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), meal coupons, cash medical benefits, group insurance, and defined contributory pension.
official_perks: Corporation residential quarters or House Rent Allowance per city classification
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme and Group Mediclaim policy coverage
Group Personal Accident Insurance and Group Term Life Insurance benefits
Meal coupons / subsidized food provisions per working day
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) once in two years with leave encashment option
Concessional housing loan, vehicle loan, and briefcase/mobile allowance

competition_benchmarks.note: LIC AAO is one of the most popular statutory corporate recruitments in India, with high applicant volumes competing for centralized public life insurance officer positions.
